title.narrative: In 2024, with UNICEF support MENESIC piloted the new ECE curriculum in 114 ECE centres using the Brief Early Childhood Quality Inventory (BEQI) tool, reaching 4,000 children. This marks the first time MENESIC has used a data-driven approach to assess curricula, strengthening institutional capacity to generate and use data for decision-making.;;
